stages.name: dyad
stages.claim: where the retention slide left off: i hears one known neighbour

stages.name: selection
stages.claim: selection: on a network i picks a neighbour j_e uniformly at random, and we do not see which

stages.name: frames
stages.claim: the outcome x_i^+ = x_i^- + delta_e is all we observe; selection, retention and the kernel are latent

stages.name: backward
stages.claim: use EM to infer the model from data: from observed updates to the kernel, pi and the attended neighbour
